description: This file contains implementation of X509_VERIFY_PARAM functions and related structures for OpenSSL, including parameter inheritance, setting, and lookup functions.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new X509_VERIFY_PARAM structure.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with an X509_VERIFY_PARAM structure.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_inherit
methods.description: Inherits parameters from one X509_VERIFY_PARAM to another based on flags.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set1
methods.description: Copies parameters from one X509_VERIFY_PARAM to another.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set1_name
methods.description: Sets the name field of the verify parameters.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set_flags
methods.description: Sets specific flags in the verify parameters.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_clear_flags
methods.description: Clears specific flags in the verify parameters.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_get_flags
methods.description: Retrieves the current flags from the verify parameters.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set_purpose
methods.description: Sets the purpose for verification.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set_trust
methods.description: Sets the trust level for verification.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set_depth
methods.description: Sets the verification depth.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set_time_posix
methods.description: Sets the verification time using POSIX time.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set_time
methods.description: Sets the verification time.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_add0_policy
methods.description: Adds a policy to the verification parameters.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set1_policies
methods.description: Sets policies for verification.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set1_host
methods.description: Sets hostnames for verification.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_add1_host
methods.description: Adds a hostname for verification.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set_hostflags
methods.description: Sets host flags.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_get0_peername
methods.description: Gets the peer name.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set1_email
methods.description: Sets email for verification.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set1_ip
methods.description: Sets IP address for verification.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set1_ip_asc
methods.description: Sets IP address from ASCII string.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_get_depth
methods.description: Gets the verification depth.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_get0_name
methods.description: Gets the name of the verification parameters.

methods.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_lookup
methods.description: Looks up verification parameters by name.
